scope: Connect the existing bounded dxfRW MULTILEADER writer to the strict dx_iface entity route for one generated AC1027 rooted MLEADER profile; preserve all unsupported graph and field refusals

authority.title: Autodesk MLeader Context Data Group Codes (DXF)
rules: The documented context group set includes the content base position, text normal/location/direction, block content fields, MLeader plane vectors, and leader vertices.
Context group 290 indicates MTEXT presence and group 296 indicates block content presence; their field payloads are distinct.

authority.title: Autodesk MLeader Leader Line Group Codes (DXF)
authority.rule: Leader-line DXF records contain repeated vertex and break data plus line-specific override fields and references.

behavior: Strict adapter preflight still validates the MLEADER owner, rooted MLEADERSTYLE, and every selected reference role before entity emission.
The prior unconditional rejection was removed; DRW::MLEADER now dispatches to dxfRW::writeMultiLeader, whose version, payload, CMC, legacy-array, and handle-remap guards remain active.
A generated AC1027 source with a rooted STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE, text STYLE, LTYPE, BLOCK_RECORD targets, one context root, one leader line, and MTEXT content exports in both ASCII and Binary DXF.
Fresh readback verifies selected root/line/context coordinates and text plus unique remapped MLEADERSTYLE, STYLE, LTYPE, and BLOCK_RECORD target roles.
Unrooted ownership/reference graphs and each existing wrong-kind/dangling/owner graph control remain refused with destination preservation.

An unrepresentable DWG CMC RGB extension is refused atomically; after restoring the model field, the same dx_iface instance successfully retries and reads back. Successful write and retry preserve the caller's source handle, owner, references, and corrected model state.

control.generator: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp; both input encodings and temporary output files are created and removed at runtime
control.fixtureDisposition: No drawing fixture was added or committed.
control.profileLimit: The adapter integration control is AC1027 only. The existing low-level writer version test retains the pre-AC1021 refusal check.

limitations: Generated source/typed readback verifies selected transport only; it does not establish a producer-authored legal tuple matrix or independent semantic interpretation.
No physical DWG producer, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or native CAD display/evaluation was exercised.

Other MLEADER field combinations, legacy/pre-R2010 profiles, unsupported content types, unsupported CMC forms, and DWG AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData source-to-output behavior remain unqualified or refused.
